title: Turán type problems for a fixed graph and a linear forest

overview.en: Determines exact Turán numbers when a fixed graph of chromatic number at least three and a linear forest are both forbidden.
overview.zh: 研究同时禁用固定图与线性森林时的极值问题，确定相应条件下的精确 Turán 数。

title: Edge Version of the Inducibility via the Entropy Method
venue: The Electronic Journal of Combinatorics 33(2), P2.17 (2026)

overview.en: Uses entropy to study the maximum number of induced copies of a graph in a host graph with a prescribed number of edges, including bounds for paths and cycles.
overview.zh: 利用熵方法研究给定边数下的诱导子图计数，并给出路与圈的相关上界。

title: Generalized Turán problems for a matching and long cycles

overview.en: Determines clique counts and edge maxima in graphs with bounded matching number and no long cycles, including the corresponding extremal structures.
overview.zh: 研究同时限制匹配数与最长圈时的团计数和边数极值，并刻画相关极值结构。

title: On the minimum size of an edge-pancyclic graph of a given order

overview.en: Improves the lower and upper bounds on the minimum number of edges in an edge-pancyclic graph of a given order.
overview.zh: 针对给定顶点数的边泛圈图，改进其最小边数的上下界。

title: Turán number of complete bipartite graphs with bounded matching number

overview.en: Studies the maximum edge count of complete-bipartite-free graphs with bounded matching number, obtaining exact values in several parameter ranges.
overview.zh: 研究匹配数有界且禁用完全二部图时的最大边数，在若干参数范围内确定精确值。

title: scButterfly: a versatile single-cell cross-modality translation method via dual-aligned variational autoencoders

overview.en: A collaborative study of single-cell cross-modality translation using dual-aligned variational autoencoders and data augmentation.
overview.zh: 关于单细胞跨模态转换的合作研究，采用双重对齐变分自编码器与数据增强方法。

title: The second-order term for the largest r-fork-free families

overview.en: Determines the second-order term in the maximum size of an r-fork-free set family through a construction on adjacent middle levels.
overview.zh: 通过相邻中间层上的构造，确定最大 r-fork-free 集合族规模的二阶项。

title: A Vertex-Linear Threshold for Eventually Turán good and the Cluster Method

overview.en: Establishes a vertex-linear Turán-good threshold using a cluster method, and applies it to monotonicity of normalized chromatic polynomials.
overview.zh: 利用 Cluster 方法得到顶点数线性的 Turán-good 阈值，并应用于归一化色多项式的单调性问题。

title: Turán-good monotonicity thresholds

overview.en: Obtains an edge-linear sufficient condition for the Turán-good property and counterexamples to monotonicity, together with bounds on monotonicity thresholds.
overview.zh: 给出边数线性的 Turán-good 充分条件、单调性猜想的反例，以及相应单调性阈值的界。

title: The (t,p)-Norm in Classical Extremal Problems

overview.en: Determines extremal degree-norm values and families for hypergraphs with restrictions on matchings, intersections, or expansion paths.
overview.zh: 研究匹配、交集和扩张路限制下超图度范数的极值，并刻画相关极值集合族。

title: Counting Cycles in Graphs with Bounded Circumference

overview.en: Studies sharp cycle-counting problems in graphs with bounded circumference and related forbidden-path settings.
overview.zh: 研究最长圈有界图中的精确圈计数问题，以及相关禁用路情形。

title: A generalization of Erdős-Hajnal problem on paths with equal-degree endpoints

overview.en: Confirms a conjecture of Chen and Ma on fixed odd-length paths whose endpoints have equal degree.
overview.zh: 证明 Chen–Ma 关于等度端点的固定奇数长度路的猜想。

title: Hypergraph extensions of the Alon–Frankl Theorem and rainbow Turán problems

overview.en: Studies hypergraph versions of bounded-matching Turán problems for graph expansions, together with rainbow Turán problems.
overview.zh: 研究图扩张对应的超图有界匹配 Turán 问题，以及相关彩虹 Turán 问题。
